title: Merge Set
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5; 2 \le M \le 2 \times 10^5; 1 \le \sum_{i=1}^{N} A_i \le 5 \times 10^5; 1 \le S_{i,j} \le M(1 \le i \le N,1 \le j \le A_i); S_{i,j} \neq S_{i,k}(1 \le j < k \le A_i); All values in the input are integers.
